messages:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — now that the rollout is live, we need to decide how to split effort between urgent fixes and follow-on enhancements. Proposing a 3-day hotfix window for P0/P1s, then a 2-week dev slice for enhancements. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Liam O'Connor: Sounds reasonable. Can we be explicit about criteria? I suggest: severity + number of affected customers + regression vs new bug + rollback risk. Anything that blocks core flows -> P0.

Sam Rivera: Agree on criteria. Also: if a bug has an easy patch (<4h) and high customer impact, it goes into hotfix no question. For larger refactors, queue into the enhancement slice and mark with an eval case.

Anna Chen: Observability note — we already have a spike in latency traces from the new streaming path. Putting a dashboard pin and alert there. If it correlates with increased 95p latency, escalate to hotfix.

Maya Patel: Good call Anna. Liam/Sam — can one of you put the triage rubric into the backlog ticket? Quick checklist would help support and SEs route properly.

Liam O'Connor: On it. I'll add a small checklist in the ticket and a label taxonomy: hotfix/p0, hotfix/p1, followon-enhancement, backlog-low. Also add 'customer-requested' tag.

Jordan Brooks: Heads up — Dedicated infra is slightly constrained this week due to a maintenance window, so any hotfix that needs extra capacity (large re-training / heavy offline jobs) should be scheduled after Friday or run on a small-canary pool.

Sam Rivera: Noted. We'll prioritize patches that are purely code/config changes first. For anything requiring infra bump, we can postpone to next week and communicate to the affected customers.

Maya Patel: Proposed rollout plan then: 72hr hotfix window for P0/P1s (owners assigned within 2h), triage meeting daily at 11am, enhancements groomed by end of next sprint planning. Support to open a curated PR with repro steps for each hotfix candidate.

Liam O'Connor: Adding a tiny triage template to the ticket: 1) Repro steps 2) Customer impact 3) Rollback plan 4) Est hours 5) Owner. Paste below for quick copy:

```
Triage template:
- Repro: <steps>
- Impact: <# customers, blocked flows>
- Severity: P0|P1|P2
- Rollback: <yes/no + steps>
- Est effort: <hrs>
- Owner: <@handle>
- Notes: <observability links, example traces>
```

Anna Chen: I'll link the latency traces and set a severity mapping so alerts map into the P0/P1 buckets automatically.

deploy-bot: Deployment 2026-03-20T15:02Z: canary to 10% completed :rocket: (no errors)

Maya Patel: Nice. If canary stays green we'll push the hotfixes through today for anything identified as P0. Everyone else — please add candidate items to the "postlaunch-hotfix" board by EOD. We'll reconvene in the 11am triage. :calendar:
